title_en: if I did and if I had done; conditionals review; I wish (Exercises 94–102)
title_vi: if I did, if I had done và I wish
theory_html:
A. Exercises in this group

A. Các bài tập trong nhóm

Exercise 94: Match the beginning of each sentence with the most suitable ending.

Bài 94: Nối phần đầu mỗi câu với phần kết phù hợp nhất.

Exercise 95: Complete the conversations with suitable verbs.

Bài 95: Hoàn thành đoạn hội thoại với động từ thích hợp.

Exercise 96: Read the article. For each number, write a comment beginning with If.

Bài 96: Đọc bài báo. Với mỗi số, viết một nhận xét bắt đầu bằng If.

Exercise 97: What would you say in each situation? Begin each sentence with If.

Bài 97: Bạn sẽ nói gì trong mỗi tình huống? Bắt đầu mỗi câu bằng If.

Exercise 98: Use your own ideas to complete the sentences.

Bài 98: Dùng ý của bạn để hoàn thành câu.

Exercise 99: For each pair of sentences, complete sentence b so that it means the same as sentence a.

Bài 99: Với mỗi cặp câu, hoàn thành câu b sao cho cùng nghĩa với câu a.

Exercise 100: Look at the pictures and write what each person wishes, using the words given.

Bài 100: Nhìn tranh và viết điều mỗi người ước, dùng từ cho sẵn.

Exercise 101: Jake and Martin share a room at college. Read what they say about each other. Then write sentences beginning I wish he would / wouldn’t.

Bài 101: Jake và Martin ở chung phòng ký túc xá. Đọc những gì họ nói về nhau. Rồi viết câu bắt đầu bằng I wish he would / wouldn’t.

Exercise 102: Complete the conversations using wish.

Bài 102: Hoàn thành đoạn hội thoại dùng wish.

B. Related units

B. Các unit liên quan

English Grammar in Use, Units 25 and 38–41 (theory below).

English Grammar in Use, Unit 25 và 38–41 (lý thuyết bên dưới).

mcq.question: If you had been promoted, ___
mcq.a: would you have made any changes?
mcq.c: you wouldn’t need to wear a suit.
mcq.full: If you had been promoted, would you have made any changes?
mcq.vi: Nếu bạn được thăng chức, bạn có thay đổi gì không?
mcq.expl:
if + past → would + base form (imaginary present / future); if + past perfect → would have + past participle (imaginary past).
if + quá khứ → would + nguyên mẫu (tưởng tượng ở hiện tại / tương lai); if + quá khứ hoàn thành → would have + quá khứ phân từ (tưởng tượng về quá khứ).
Điểm ngữ pháp: if + had been → would have + V3.
mcq.key: If you had been promoted, ___|would you have made any changes?

mcq.question: If you were rude to the boss, ___
mcq.b: you’d be able to change the system.
mcq.c: you wouldn’t need to wear a suit.
mcq.full: If you were rude to the boss, you’d probably regret it later.
mcq.vi: Nếu bạn thô lỗ với sếp, có lẽ sau này bạn sẽ hối hận.
mcq.expl:
if + past → would + base form (imaginary present / future); if + past perfect → would have + past participle (imaginary past).
if + quá khứ → would + nguyên mẫu (tưởng tượng ở hiện tại / tương lai); if + quá khứ hoàn thành → would have + quá khứ phân từ (tưởng tượng về quá khứ).
Điểm ngữ pháp: if + quá khứ → would + V.
mcq.key: If you were rude to the boss, ___|you’d probably regret it later.

mcq.question: If you were promoted, ___
mcq.a: you’d be able to change the system.
mcq.c: would you have left the firm?
mcq.full: If you were promoted, you’d be able to change the system.
mcq.vi: Nếu bạn được thăng chức, bạn sẽ có thể thay đổi hệ thống.
mcq.expl:
if + past → would + base form (imaginary present / future); if + past perfect → would have + past participle (imaginary past).
if + quá khứ → would + nguyên mẫu (tưởng tượng ở hiện tại / tương lai); if + quá khứ hoàn thành → would have + quá khứ phân từ (tưởng tượng về quá khứ).
Điểm ngữ pháp: if + quá khứ → would + V.
mcq.key: If you were promoted, ___|you’d be able to change the system.

mcq.question: If you hadn’t been promoted, ___
mcq.a: would you have left the firm?
mcq.b: you’d be able to change the system.
mcq.c: would you have made any changes?
mcq.full: If you hadn’t been promoted, would you have left the firm?
mcq.vi: Nếu bạn không được thăng chức, bạn có rời công ty không?
mcq.expl:
if + past → would + base form (imaginary present / future); if + past perfect → would have + past participle (imaginary past).
if + quá khứ → would + nguyên mẫu (tưởng tượng ở hiện tại / tương lai); if + quá khứ hoàn thành → would have + quá khứ phân từ (tưởng tượng về quá khứ).
Điểm ngữ pháp: if + hadn’t been → would have + V3.
mcq.key: If you hadn’t been promoted, ___|would you have left the firm?

mcq.question: If you had lost your job, ___
mcq.b: you’d be able to change the system.
mcq.c: would you have left the firm?
mcq.full: If you had lost your job, you’d have been very upset.
mcq.vi: Nếu bạn mất việc, bạn hẳn đã rất buồn.
mcq.expl:
if + past → would + base form (imaginary present / future); if + past perfect → would have + past participle (imaginary past).
if + quá khứ → would + nguyên mẫu (tưởng tượng ở hiện tại / tương lai); if + quá khứ hoàn thành → would have + quá khứ phân từ (tưởng tượng về quá khứ).
Điểm ngữ pháp: if + had lost → would have + V3.
mcq.key: If you had lost your job, ___|you’d have been very upset.

mcq.question: If you worked from home, ___
mcq.a: you wouldn’t need to wear a suit.
mcq.c: would you have made any changes?
mcq.full: If you worked from home, you wouldn’t need to wear a suit.
mcq.vi: Nếu bạn làm việc ở nhà, bạn sẽ không cần mặc com-lê.
mcq.expl:
if + past → would + base form (imaginary present / future); if + past perfect → would have + past participle (imaginary past).
if + quá khứ → would + nguyên mẫu (tưởng tượng ở hiện tại / tương lai); if + quá khứ hoàn thành → would have + quá khứ phân từ (tưởng tượng về quá khứ).
Điểm ngữ pháp: if + quá khứ → would + V.
mcq.key: If you worked from home, ___|you wouldn’t need to wear a suit.

mcq.question: If you were fired, ___
mcq.b: would you have made any changes?
mcq.c: you’d be able to change the system.
mcq.full: If you were fired, you wouldn’t get a reference.
mcq.vi: Nếu bạn bị sa thải, bạn sẽ không được thư giới thiệu.
mcq.expl:
if + past → would + base form (imaginary present / future); if + past perfect → would have + past participle (imaginary past).
if + quá khứ → would + nguyên mẫu (tưởng tượng ở hiện tại / tương lai); if + quá khứ hoàn thành → would have + quá khứ phân từ (tưởng tượng về quá khứ).
Điểm ngữ pháp: if + quá khứ → would + V.
mcq.key: If you were fired, ___|you wouldn’t get a reference.

mcq.question: Why didn’t you go to the lecture last night? – I didn’t know about it. – So would you have gone if you ___?
mcq.full: Why didn’t you go to the lecture last night? – I didn’t know about it. – So would you have gone if you had known?
mcq.vi: Sao tối qua bạn không đi nghe giảng? – Mình không biết. – Vậy nếu bạn biết thì bạn có đi không?
mcq.expl:
if + had + past participle → would have + past participle (past); if + past → would + base form (present).
if + had + quá khứ phân từ → would have + quá khứ phân từ (quá khứ); if + quá khứ → would + nguyên mẫu (hiện tại).
Điểm ngữ pháp: would have gone ↔ if + had + V3.
mcq.key: Why didn’t you go to the lecture last night? – I didn’t know about it. – So would you have gone if you ___?|had known

mcq.question: I don’t know why Jane works in this lab. I ___ something worthwhile if I ___ her qualifications.
mcq.full: I don’t know why Jane works in this lab. I’d do something worthwhile if I had her qualifications.
mcq.vi: Mình không hiểu sao Jane làm ở phòng thí nghiệm này. Nếu mình có bằng cấp như cô ấy, mình sẽ làm điều gì đó đáng giá.
mcq.expl:
if + had + past participle → would have + past participle (past); if + past → would + base form (present).
if + had + quá khứ phân từ → would have + quá khứ phân từ (quá khứ); if + quá khứ → would + nguyên mẫu (hiện tại).
Điểm ngữ pháp: would + V … if + quá khứ.
mcq.key: I don’t know why Jane works in this lab. I ___ something worthwhile if I ___ her qualifications.|’d do … had

mcq.question: Why did you ask Veronica about her boyfriend? – I didn’t realise they’d split up. If I ___, I ___ her about him.
mcq.full: Why did you ask Veronica about her boyfriend? – I didn’t realise they’d split up. If I’d known, I wouldn’t have asked her about him.
mcq.vi: Sao bạn hỏi Veronica về bạn trai cô ấy? – Mình không biết họ chia tay rồi. Nếu biết, mình đã không hỏi cô ấy về anh ta.
mcq.expl:
if + had + past participle → would have + past participle (past); if + past → would + base form (present).
if + had + quá khứ phân từ → would have + quá khứ phân từ (quá khứ); if + quá khứ → would + nguyên mẫu (hiện tại).
Điểm ngữ pháp: if + had + V3 → wouldn’t have + V3.
mcq.key: Why did you ask Veronica about her boyfriend? – I didn’t realise they’d split up. If I ___, I ___ her about him.|’d known … wouldn’t have asked

mcq.question: Ouch! I’ve hurt my knee. – Well, that was your own fault. You ___ it if you ___ that text.
mcq.a: wouldn’t have hurt … hadn’t been reading
mcq.full: Ouch! I’ve hurt my knee. – Well, that was your own fault. You wouldn’t have hurt it if you hadn’t been reading that text.
mcq.vi: Ối! Mình đau đầu gối rồi. – Lỗi của bạn đấy. Bạn đã không bị đau nếu không mải đọc tin nhắn.
mcq.expl:
if + had + past participle → would have + past participle (past); if + past → would + base form (present).
if + had + quá khứ phân từ → would have + quá khứ phân từ (quá khứ); if + quá khứ → would + nguyên mẫu (hiện tại).
Điểm ngữ pháp: wouldn’t have + V3 … if + hadn’t been + V-ing.
mcq.key: Ouch! I’ve hurt my knee. – Well, that was your own fault. You ___ it if you ___ that text.|wouldn’t have hurt … hadn’t been reading

mcq.question: Do you love me? – You know I do. – OK, but would you still ___ me if I ___ poor?
mcq.full: Do you love me? – You know I do. – OK, but would you still love me if I were poor?
mcq.vi: Em có yêu anh không? – Anh biết mà. – Ừ, nhưng em có còn yêu anh nếu anh nghèo không?
mcq.expl:
if + had + past participle → would have + past participle (past); if + past → would + base form (present).
if + had + quá khứ phân từ → would have + quá khứ phân từ (quá khứ); if + quá khứ → would + nguyên mẫu (hiện tại).
Điểm ngữ pháp: would + V … if + quá khứ (were).
mcq.key: Do you love me? – You know I do. – OK, but would you still ___ me if I ___ poor?|love … were

mcq.question: Well, yes, I am rich. But if I ___ all my money, what ___? – I’d say goodbye.
mcq.full: Well, yes, I am rich. But if I lost all my money, what would you do? – I’d say goodbye.
mcq.vi: Ừ, anh giàu. Nhưng nếu anh mất hết tiền, em sẽ làm gì? – Em sẽ nói lời tạm biệt.
mcq.expl:
if + had + past participle → would have + past participle (past); if + past → would + base form (present).
if + had + quá khứ phân từ → would have + quá khứ phân từ (quá khứ); if + quá khứ → would + nguyên mẫu (hiện tại).
Điểm ngữ pháp: if + quá khứ → would + V.
mcq.key: Well, yes, I am rich. But if I ___ all my money, what ___? – I’d say goodbye.|lost … would you do

mcq.question: (Tanya did a world tour last year. That meant she had to spend five months travelling.) If she hadn’t done a world tour last year, she ___ five months travelling.
mcq.full: (Tanya did a world tour last year. That meant she had to spend five months travelling.) If she hadn’t done a world tour last year, she wouldn’t have spent five months travelling.
mcq.vi: (Năm ngoái Tanya lưu diễn vòng quanh thế giới, nên phải đi suốt năm tháng.) Nếu năm ngoái cô không lưu diễn, cô đã không phải đi suốt năm tháng.
mcq.expl:
Imagining a different past: If + had (not) + past participle, … would (not) have + past participle.
Tưởng tượng quá khứ khác đi: If + had (not) + quá khứ phân từ, … would (not) have + quá khứ phân từ.
Điểm ngữ pháp: if + hadn’t + V3 → wouldn’t have + V3.
mcq.key: (Tanya did a world tour last year. That meant she had to spend five months travelling.) If she hadn’t done a world tour last year, she ___ five months travelling.|wouldn’t have spent

mcq.question: (She didn’t have a holiday last year, so she got terribly tired and stressed.) If she ___ a holiday last year, she wouldn’t have got terribly tired and stressed.
mcq.full: (She didn’t have a holiday last year, so she got terribly tired and stressed.) If she’d had a holiday last year, she wouldn’t have got terribly tired and stressed.
mcq.vi: (Năm ngoái cô không nghỉ phép nên rất mệt mỏi và căng thẳng.) Nếu năm ngoái cô được nghỉ, cô đã không mệt mỏi căng thẳng như thế.
mcq.expl:
Imagining a different past: If + had (not) + past participle, … would (not) have + past participle.
Tưởng tượng quá khứ khác đi: If + had (not) + quá khứ phân từ, … would (not) have + quá khứ phân từ.
Điểm ngữ pháp: if + had + V3.
mcq.key: (She didn’t have a holiday last year, so she got terribly tired and stressed.) If she ___ a holiday last year, she wouldn’t have got terribly tired and stressed.|’d had

mcq.question: (Her manager had contracted her to record a new album after the tour, so he panicked.) If her manager hadn’t contracted her to record a new album, he ___.
mcq.full: (Her manager had contracted her to record a new album after the tour, so he panicked.) If her manager hadn’t contracted her to record a new album, he wouldn’t have panicked.
mcq.vi: (Quản lý đã ký hợp đồng thu album mới sau tour nên hoảng hốt.) Nếu quản lý không ký hợp đồng thu album mới, ông ấy đã không hoảng.
mcq.expl:
Imagining a different past: If + had (not) + past participle, … would (not) have + past participle.
Tưởng tượng quá khứ khác đi: If + had (not) + quá khứ phân từ, … would (not) have + quá khứ phân từ.
Điểm ngữ pháp: wouldn’t have + V3.
mcq.key: (Her manager had contracted her to record a new album after the tour, so he panicked.) If her manager hadn’t contracted her to record a new album, he ___.|wouldn’t have panicked

mcq.question: (The tour was such a huge success that she was able to postpone the recording.) If the tour hadn’t been such a huge success, she ___ able to postpone the recording for two months.
mcq.full: (The tour was such a huge success that she was able to postpone the recording.) If the tour hadn’t been such a huge success, she wouldn’t have been able to postpone the recording for two months.
mcq.vi: (Tour thành công lớn đến mức cô có thể hoãn thu âm.) Nếu tour không thành công lớn, cô đã không thể hoãn thu âm hai tháng.
mcq.expl:
Imagining a different past: If + had (not) + past participle, … would (not) have + past participle.
Tưởng tượng quá khứ khác đi: If + had (not) + quá khứ phân từ, … would (not) have + quá khứ phân từ.
Điểm ngữ pháp: wouldn’t have been able to.
mcq.key: (The tour was such a huge success that she was able to postpone the recording.) If the tour hadn’t been such a huge success, she ___ able to postpone the recording for two months.|wouldn’t have been

mcq.question: (Her manager sent her to a luxury spa hotel, and she met Hossein.) If her manager hadn’t sent her to a luxury spa hotel, she ___ Hossein.
mcq.full: (Her manager sent her to a luxury spa hotel, and she met Hossein.) If her manager hadn’t sent her to a luxury spa hotel, she wouldn’t have met Hossein.
mcq.vi: (Quản lý gửi cô đến khách sạn spa sang trọng và cô gặp Hossein.) Nếu quản lý không gửi cô đến khách sạn spa, cô đã không gặp Hossein.
mcq.expl:
Imagining a different past: If + had (not) + past participle, … would (not) have + past participle.
Tưởng tượng quá khứ khác đi: If + had (not) + quá khứ phân từ, … would (not) have + quá khứ phân từ.
Điểm ngữ pháp: wouldn’t have + V3.
mcq.key: (Her manager sent her to a luxury spa hotel, and she met Hossein.) If her manager hadn’t sent her to a luxury spa hotel, she ___ Hossein.|wouldn’t have met

mcq.question: (He should have been doing research in California, but he was recovering from a bad skiing accident.) If Hossein hadn’t been recovering from a bad skiing accident, he ___ research in California.
mcq.full: (He should have been doing research in California, but he was recovering from a bad skiing accident.) If Hossein hadn’t been recovering from a bad skiing accident, he would have been doing research in California.
mcq.vi: (Lẽ ra anh đang nghiên cứu ở California, nhưng anh đang hồi phục sau tai nạn trượt tuyết.) Nếu Hossein không đang hồi phục sau tai nạn, anh đã đang nghiên cứu ở California.
mcq.expl:
Imagining a different past: If + had (not) + past participle, … would (not) have + past participle.
Tưởng tượng quá khứ khác đi: If + had (not) + quá khứ phân từ, … would (not) have + quá khứ phân từ.
Điểm ngữ pháp: would have been + V-ing.
mcq.key: (He should have been doing research in California, but he was recovering from a bad skiing accident.) If Hossein hadn’t been recovering from a bad skiing accident, he ___ research in California.|would have been doing

mcq.question: (They were the only guests on their own, so they started talking.) If they hadn’t been the only guests on their own, they ___ talking.
mcq.full: (They were the only guests on their own, so they started talking.) If they hadn’t been the only guests on their own, they wouldn’t have started talking.
mcq.vi: (Họ là hai vị khách duy nhất đi một mình nên bắt chuyện.) Nếu họ không phải hai vị khách duy nhất đi một mình, họ đã không bắt chuyện.
mcq.expl:
Imagining a different past: If + had (not) + past participle, … would (not) have + past participle.
Tưởng tượng quá khứ khác đi: If + had (not) + quá khứ phân từ, … would (not) have + quá khứ phân từ.
Điểm ngữ pháp: wouldn’t have + V3.
mcq.key: (They were the only guests on their own, so they started talking.) If they hadn’t been the only guests on their own, they ___ talking.|wouldn’t have started

mcq.question: (He didn’t know who she was. He didn’t treat her like a star.) If he’d known who she was, he ___ her like a star.
mcq.full: (He didn’t know who she was. He didn’t treat her like a star.) If he’d known who she was, he would have treated her like a star.
mcq.vi: (Anh không biết cô là ai. Anh không đối xử với cô như ngôi sao.) Nếu biết cô là ai, anh đã đối xử với cô như ngôi sao.
mcq.expl:
Imagining a different past: If + had (not) + past participle, … would (not) have + past participle.
Tưởng tượng quá khứ khác đi: If + had (not) + quá khứ phân từ, … would (not) have + quá khứ phân từ.
Điểm ngữ pháp: would have + V3.
mcq.key: (He didn’t know who she was. He didn’t treat her like a star.) If he’d known who she was, he ___ her like a star.|would have treated

mcq.question: (I revised thoroughly last week. Now I can do the test.) If I hadn’t revised thoroughly, I ___ able to do the test.
mcq.full: (I revised thoroughly last week. Now I can do the test.) If I hadn’t revised thoroughly, I wouldn’t be able to do the test.
mcq.vi: (Tuần trước tôi ôn kỹ. Giờ tôi làm được bài.) Nếu không ôn kỹ, tôi sẽ không làm được bài.
mcq.expl:
A past condition with a present result: If + past perfect, … would / could + base form (now).
Điều kiện trong quá khứ, kết quả ở hiện tại: If + quá khứ hoàn thành, … would / could + nguyên mẫu (bây giờ).
Điểm ngữ pháp: If + quá khứ hoàn thành → would + V (bây giờ).
mcq.key: (I revised thoroughly last week. Now I can do the test.) If I hadn’t revised thoroughly, I ___ able to do the test.|wouldn’t be

mcq.question: (I forgot my umbrella yesterday and got wet.) If I had remembered my umbrella, I ___ wet.
mcq.full: (I forgot my umbrella yesterday and got wet.) If I had remembered my umbrella, I wouldn’t have got wet.
mcq.vi: (Hôm qua tôi quên ô và bị ướt.) Nếu nhớ mang ô, tôi đã không bị ướt.
mcq.expl:
A past condition with a present result: If + past perfect, … would / could + base form (now).
Điều kiện trong quá khứ, kết quả ở hiện tại: If + quá khứ hoàn thành, … would / could + nguyên mẫu (bây giờ).
Điểm ngữ pháp: wouldn’t have + V3.
mcq.key: (I forgot my umbrella yesterday and got wet.) If I had remembered my umbrella, I ___ wet.|wouldn’t have got

mcq.question: (You should go swimming regularly because that’s a good way to get fit.) If you go swimming regularly, ___ fit.
mcq.full: (You should go swimming regularly because that’s a good way to get fit.) If you go swimming regularly, you’ll get fit.
mcq.vi: (Bạn nên bơi thường xuyên vì đó là cách tốt để khỏe mạnh.) Nếu bơi thường xuyên, bạn sẽ khỏe mạnh.

mcq.vi: Các anh mình đang đào bể bơi. – Nghe vất vả nhỉ! – Đúng vậy. Thật ra mình đoán họ ước giá đừng bao giờ bắt đầu. Nhưng giờ không dừng được.
mcq.expl:
I wish + past for the present (I wish I had / knew); I wish + past perfect for regrets about the past (I wish I’d learned, they hadn’t moved, they’d never started).
I wish + quá khứ cho hiện tại (I wish I had / knew); I wish + quá khứ hoàn thành cho hối tiếc về quá khứ (I wish I’d learned, they hadn’t moved, they’d never started).
Điểm ngữ pháp: wish + quá khứ hoàn thành.
mcq.key: My brothers are digging a swimming pool. – That sounds like hard work! – It is. Actually, I suspect they wish they ___. But they can’t stop now.|’d never started
